capabilities: Publish notes to Sanity as published documents
Pull published Sanity documents into the vault as notes
Map Sanity schema fields to note frontmatter and back
Upload embedded body images and cover-image fields to Sanity
Publish site announcements to a Sanity singleton
disambiguation: Sanity is the name of the CMS it syncs with, not a note-validation or sanity-check tool.
extras: Not installed from the Community Plugins marketplace and marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installed manually or via BRAT. README includes a detailed section on setting up a reverse proxy (Tencent EdgeOne) for users in mainland China where the Sanity API host is unreachable.
intentEvidence: This plugin is a fork of drewlyton/sanity-obsidian-plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to a Sanity CMS project and round-trip edits between the vault and Sanity documents.

relations.evidence: This plugin is a fork of drewlyton/sanity-obsidian-plugin.

requires.name: Sanity API token with Editor or Admin role

summary: Bidirectional sync plugin that publishes Obsidian notes to a Sanity Studio and pulls Sanity documents back into the vault.
